description: This Java source file defines the class HonoChainAuthHandler, which extends ChainAuthHandlerImpl to customize exception processing in the context of the Hono project. It specifically handles ServiceInvocationException embedded within HttpStatusException during authentication failures.

classes.name: HonoChainAuthHandler
classes.description: A specialized version of Vert.x's ChainAuthHandlerImpl tailored for the Hono project. It overrides the processException method to enhance error handling by delegating to AuthHandlerTools, ensuring proper processing of ServiceInvocationException during authentication failures.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Overrides the default exception processing to delegate error handling to AuthHandlerTools.processException, ensuring that service invocation errors are properly managed during authentication failures.
